selectors.literal_quote: Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD 12) mandated the creation of new standards for interoperable identity credentials for physical and logical access to Federal government locations and systems.  Federal Information Processing Standard 201 (FIPS 201), Personal Identity Verification (PIV) of Federal Employees and Contractors, was developed to establish standards for identity credentials [FIPS201].  This document, Special Publication 800-78-3, specifies the cryptographic algorithms and key sizes for PIV systems and is a companion document to FIPS 201.

Homeland Security Presidential Directive-12 (HSPD-12) mandated the creation of new standards for interoperable identity credentials for physical and logical access to federal government locations and systems. Federal Information Processing Standard 201 (FIPS 201), Personal Identity Verification (PIV) of Federal Employees and Contractors, was developed to establish standards for identity credentials [FIPS201]. This document, NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-78-4, specifies the cryptographic algorithms and key sizes for PIV systems and is a companion document to FIPS 201-2.
